title: Finite subsets of an ideal multiplication kernel die at a later stage
statement: Let Lambda be a nonempty directed preorder, A and B functors to commutative rings, N a functor to abelian groups, and take their categorical colimits [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Each N_i is a B_i-module; the transition maps are semilinear over those of B. Let phi_i:A_i->B_i commute with all transitions, and psi:colimit A->colimit B commute with the coprojections. Equip colimit N with a colimit B-module structure compatible with its coprojections. Suppose colimit N is flat over colimit A through psi [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map]. Fix i and any ideal I of A_i. For every finite subset E of I tensor_{A_i} N_i whose elements multiply to zero, there are j, f:i->j and an additive map theta:I tensor_{A_i} N_i -> (I.map alpha_f) tensor_{A_j} N_j with theta(a tensor x)=alpha_f(a) tensor eta_f(x) and theta(k)=0 for every k in E. The A_i and A_j actions on N are through phi_i and phi_j. No Noetherian, local-ring or finite-module assumption is imposed. The forgetful functor from commutative rings to sets is assumed to preserve the specified colimit of the first ring diagram A.

source.place: Algebra, Tag 00R6, proof from choosing a fixed index through vanishing of the Tor transition map; Remark 00M6. Official text checked at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/00R6.

proof.text: For each element of the finite subset, expand it into finitely many pure tensors. Its zero multiplication gives a finite linear relation. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-colimit-flat-relation-descent] at the original independent carrier universes. Construct the canonical semilinear tensor map; tensor balancing and the column equations show it kills the element. This is the existing single-element argument assembled locally because the corrected single-element theorem has a common-universe interface. Supply the explicit PreservesColimit instance for A to this application.

By induction on a finite set of indices, directedness gives one l above i and all witness stages. Construct the canonical tensor map theta_l using TensorProduct.map on the semilinear ideal and module transitions. For the empty subset take l=i.

For a witness map f:i->j and g:j->l, A.map(g) comp A.map(f)=A.map(i->l), because the shape is a preorder. Ideal.map_map gives (I A_j) A_l=I A_l. Construct the additive tensor transition delta from the extended ideal tensor module at j to the one at l. Its composition with the witness map equals theta_l: verify on pure tensors by A and N functoriality, and extend by tensor induction. Therefore theta_l kills every element of the prescribed subset.

proof_origin.place: Tag 00R6, taking one common stage for the finitely many xi; tensor transition construction and composition are formalized explicitly. Forced universe adaptation: assemble the per-element tensor argument directly from finite-relation factorization; remaining common-stage construction unchanged. The explicit preservation hypothesis expresses the algebraic ring colimit used in Tag 00R6 and prevents the large-index/small-ring categorical-colimit error.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_stage_finite_ideal_kernel_vanishes
    {Λ : Type u} [Preorder Λ] [IsDirected Λ (· ≤ ·)] [Nonempty Λ]
    (A : Λ ⥤ CommRingCat.{v}) (B : Λ ⥤ CommRingCat.{w})
    (N : Λ ⥤ AddCommGrpCat.{z}) [HasColimit A] [HasColimit B] [HasColimit N]
    [PreservesColimit A (forget CommRingCat.{v})]
    [∀ i, Module (B.obj i) (N.obj i)]
    (φ : ∀ i, A.obj i →+* B.obj i)
    (hcomm : ∀ (i j : Λ) (f : i ⟶ j),
      (B.map f).hom.comp (φ i) = (φ j).comp (A.map f).hom)
    (hscalar : ∀ (i j : Λ) (f : i ⟶ j) (b : B.obj i) (x : N.obj i),
      (N.map f).hom (b • x) = (B.map f).hom b • (N.map f).hom x)
    (ψ : (colimit A : CommRingCat.{v}) →+* (colimit B : CommRingCat.{w}))
    (hψ : ∀ i, ψ.comp (colimit.ι A i).hom = (colimit.ι B i).hom.comp (φ i))
    [Module (colimit B : CommRingCat.{w}) (colimit N : AddCommGrpCat.{z})]
    (hlimitScalar : ∀ (i : Λ) (b : B.obj i) (x : N.obj i),
      (colimit.ι N i).hom (b • x) = (colimit.ι B i).hom b • (colimit.ι N i).hom x)
    (hflat : letI := Module.compHom (colimit N : AddCommGrpCat.{z}) ψ
      Module.Flat (colimit A : CommRingCat.{v}) (colimit N : AddCommGrpCat.{z}))
    (i : Λ) (I : Ideal (A.obj i)) :
    letI := Module.compHom (N.obj i) (φ i)
    ∀ (s : Finset (I ⊗[A.obj i] N.obj i)),
      (∀ k ∈ s,
        TensorProduct.lift ((LinearMap.lsmul (A.obj i) (N.obj i)).comp I.subtype) k = 0) →
    ∃ (j : Λ) (f : i ⟶ j),
      letI := Module.compHom (N.obj i) (φ i)
      letI := Module.compHom (N.obj j) (φ j)
      ∃ θ : I ⊗[A.obj i] N.obj i →+
          (I.map (A.map f).hom) ⊗[A.obj j] N.obj j,
        (∀ (a : I) (x : N.obj i), θ (a ⊗ₜ[A.obj i] x) =
          (⟨(A.map f).hom a, Ideal.mem_map_of_mem (A.map f).hom a.property⟩ :
            I.map (A.map f).hom) ⊗ₜ[A.obj j] (N.map f).hom x) ∧
        (∀ k ∈ s, θ k = 0)
